ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

exposed_dft_features.name: CMD19 SEND_TUNING_BLOCK
exposed_dft_features.purpose: UHS-I sampling-point calibration on the host side; the card transmits a fixed 64-byte (4-bit) or 8-byte (1-bit) pattern that the host uses to find the optimal sampling phase. Functionally a built-in lane-deskew DFT mechanism.

exposed_dft_features.name: Loopback via SPI mode
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Software self-test using SPI mode with CRC enable (CMD59) — CRC mismatch path is exercisable.

exposed_dft_features.name: CSR error bits
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Card Status Register reports all detected protocol errors (COM_CRC_ERROR, ILLEGAL_COMMAND, ADDRESS_ERROR, OUT_OF_RANGE, WP_VIOLATION, CARD_ECC_FAILED, CC_ERROR).

exposed_dft_features.name: ACMD22 SEND_NUM_WR_BLOCKS
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Read back the number of successfully written blocks — built-in observability for multi-block write integrity.

exposed_dft_features.name: ACMD13 SD_STATUS
exposed_dft_features.purpose: 512-bit SD Status with detailed performance, AU size, erase parameters, command-queue support — built-in observability.

fields.no_jtag_on_edge_connector: There is no JTAG / scan / boundary-scan port on the SD card edge connector. Vendor SiP debug uses internal JTAG accessed at wafer/package probe, not over the SD bus.
fields.notes: SD Memory Card has no formal DFT / scan architecture exposed at the bus interface. Tuning (CMD19) and the SPI loopback path are the only protocol-level observability features. Internal NAND test, ECC scrub, and read margining are vendor-specific and out of scope.
